_comment: LIVE golden: Link's FRONT_ROLL body Co cylinder centre, captured on GZLJ01 (flooded Hyrule, 2026-07-06) with Link rolling PINNED against a wall so current.pos and shape_angle.y are constant and only the rollf pose moves mCyl's centre.
